title: LevelUP! Tome Expansion Pack 2
description: 14 More tomes for the LevelUP datapack! This time focusing on more gimmicky and interesting abilities!
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d388931f2ea7f9d1c59fdc3b4e66241a434a1ee5.png) # LevelUP! Tome Expansion #2 Adds 12 new skill tomes for the LevelUP! datapack. These tomes go a bit further than the first tome expansion and try to add more interesting and gimmiky abilities. This is an addon for the LevelUP! datapack and will not function without it. ## New Tomes Added
Tome of Distant Combat Weapon Throwing :
-15% Damage
-75% Attack Damage
You can throw your weapons giviing them 6x of their normal range.
Knowledge Point Cost : 25
Obtained via a 25% drop chance from vaults
Tome of Awareness Radar Detector :
Crouch to see the locations of nearby mobs.
>Knowledge Point Cost : 25
Obtained via a 25% drop chance from vaults
Tome of Rebuke Retaliator :
+15% Health
Getting hit deals 50% of your current health back to your attacker as damage.
You cannot attack normally.
>Knowledge Point Cost : 65
Obtained via a drop from piglin brutes when killed by thorns damage
Tome of Fortification Stronghold :
+15% Health
+50% Armor
+25% Armor Toughness
You are immune to knockback.
Knowledge Point Cost :
Obtained via a 25% chance from any chest in the stronghold
Tome of Unbridled Rage (CURRENTLY BROKEN WILL BE FIXED NEXT UPDATE) Berserker :
Getting hit while below 40% of your max health causes you to enrage for 15 seconds.
Enraging gives you temporary health based on your max health and a strength buff.
5 minute cooldown.
Knowledge Point Cost : 25
Obtained via a 2% drop chance from zombified piglins
Tome of Fire Mastery Flare Sigil :
+50% Damage while on fire.
Knowledge Point Cost : 10
Obtained via crafting
Tome of Water Mastery Aspect of the Axolotl :
+50% Damage while in water.
Knowledge Point Cost : 10
Obtained via crafting
Tome of Air Mastery Aerial Ace :
+50% Damage while airborne.
Knowledge Point Cost : 15
Obtained via crafting
Tome of Earth Mastery Grounded :
+50% Damage while on the ground.
Knowledge Point Cost : 15
Obtained via crafting
Tome of Violence BLOOD//IS//FUEL :
+10 Health
+20% Health
-25% Armor
You take damage over time, faster when in combat.
Killing something heals you to full health.
Knowledge Point Cost : 50
Obtained via a from vindicators with the strength effect when killed by a player with the weakness effect (the vindicator cannot have weakness and the player cannot have strength)
Tome of Hellfire Hellfire Constitution :
You gain a regeneration effect while on fire.
The effect is faster while directly in fire or lava.
Knowledge Point Cost : 30
Obtained via a 35% chance to drop in nether fortress chests
Tome of Darkness Warden's Wrath :
-25% Armor
Holding crouch charges up a sonic boom attack.
The attack does more damage the more armor and armor toughness you have.
Knowledge Point Cost : 30
Obtained via crafting
Tome of Movement Accelerator :
+2% Speed
+0.5% Attack Speed
This tomes stats are multiplied by how many stacks you have.
Killing something gives you 50 stacks.
Stacks cap out at 250 and deplete at a rate of 20 per second.
Knowledge Point Cost : 25
Obtained via a 10% chance to drop from ocelots
Tome of Peace Nirvana :
You become immune to all status effects.
Knowledge Point Cost : 30
Obtained via a 10% drop chance from witches
